subject: Biology SL
question: Answer all parts using the shared scatter-plot data.

stimulus.title: Leaf chlorophyll concentration and net photosynthetic rate
stimulus.description: Researchers measured chlorophyll concentration and net photosynthetic rate in ten leaves from the same plant species. Light intensity, carbon dioxide concentration and temperature were standardized during the photosynthesis measurements.
stimulus.yLabel: Net photosynthetic rate (µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹)
stimulus.note: The straight line shows a best-fit trend for these data.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Describe the relationship between chlorophyll concentration and net photosynthetic rate.
markscheme: There is a positive relationship: leaves with higher chlorophyll concentration generally have a higher net photosynthetic rate.
markschemeJa: 正の関係があり、クロロフィル濃度が高い葉ほど一般に正味光合成速度が高い。
parts.modelAnswer: There is a positive relationship between chlorophyll concentration and net photosynthetic rate.
parts.modelAnswerJa: クロロフィル濃度と正味光合成速度には正の関係があります。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: The graph shows R² = 0.88 for the fitted trend. Interpret this value in the context of the investigation.
markscheme: An R² value of 0.88 indicates that the fitted relationship explains a large proportion (about 88%) of the variation in net photosynthetic rate in these observations.
The value supports a strong association in this dataset but does not by itself prove that differences in chlorophyll concentration caused the differences in photosynthetic rate.
markschemeJa: R²＝0.88は、この当てはめた関係によって観察された正味光合成速度の変動の大部分（約88%）が説明されることを示す。
この値はこのデータ内で強い関連を支持するが、クロロフィル濃度の違いが光合成速度の違いを引き起こしたことをそれだけで証明するものではない。
parts.modelAnswer: R² = 0.88 means that the fitted trend accounts for about 88% of the observed variation in net photosynthetic rate. This is consistent with a strong association, but correlation alone does not establish causation.
parts.modelAnswerJa: R²＝0.88は、当てはめた傾向が観察された正味光合成速度の変動の約88%を説明することを意味します。強い関連を示しますが、相関だけでは因果関係を証明できません。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain one biological reason why increased chlorophyll concentration could be associated with a higher photosynthetic rate.
markscheme: Chlorophyll absorbs light energy used to drive the light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis.
Greater light absorption can support greater production of ATP and reduced electron carriers for carbon fixation, provided another factor is not limiting.
markschemeJa: クロロフィルは光合成の光依存反応を進めるために使われる光エネルギーを吸収する。
他の要因が制限していなければ、光吸収の増加によってATPや還元型電子運搬体の生成が増え、炭素固定を支えられる。
parts.modelAnswer: Chlorophyll absorbs light energy for the light-dependent reactions. If other factors are not limiting, more light absorption can support greater production of ATP and reduced electron carriers and therefore a higher rate of carbon fixation.
parts.modelAnswerJa: クロロフィルは光依存反応に使われる光エネルギーを吸収します。他の要因が制限していなければ、光吸収が増えることでATPや還元型電子運搬体の生成が増え、炭素固定速度を高めることができます。

parts.label: (d)
parts.question: Suggest one additional measurement that would help test whether another factor contributes to the variation in photosynthetic rate.
markscheme: Measure a relevant additional factor such as leaf nitrogen content, stomatal conductance, leaf age or another variable that could influence photosynthesis, and test its relationship with photosynthetic rate.
markschemeJa: 葉の窒素含量、気孔コンダクタンス、葉齢など光合成に影響しうる別の要因を測定し、光合成速度との関係を調べる。
parts.modelAnswer: For example, stomatal conductance could be measured and compared with photosynthetic rate.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 例えば気孔コンダクタンスを測定し、光合成速度との関係を比較できます。

subject: Biology SL
question: Answer all parts using the shared frequency-distribution data.

stimulus.title: Leaf length in a plant population
stimulus.description: Leaf length was measured for 60 mature leaves collected randomly from plants of the same species in one population.
stimulus.note: Each leaf was assigned to one non-overlapping 5 mm class.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.question: Identify the modal class.
markscheme: 45–49 mm, because it has the highest frequency (18).
markschemeJa: 45–49 mm。頻度が18で最も高いため。

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.question: Identify the class interval that contains the median leaf length.
markscheme: 45–49 mm; with 60 observations, the 30th and 31st values lie in this class because the cumulative frequency reaches 25 by 40–44 mm and 43 by 45–49 mm.
markschemeJa: 45–49 mm。60個のデータでは30番目・31番目が中央値に対応し、40–44 mmまでの累積頻度は25、45–49 mmまでで43になるため、この階級に含まれる。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Describe the variation in leaf length shown by the distribution.
markscheme: Leaf length shows continuous variation across multiple adjacent classes rather than separate categories.
The distribution is unimodal, with most observations concentrated around the middle classes and fewer leaves at the shortest and longest classes.
markschemeJa: 葉長は離散的な区分ではなく、隣接する複数の階級にわたる連続変異を示している。
分布は単峰型で、中間の階級に多く、最も短い・長い階級では少ない。
parts.modelAnswer: Leaf length varies continuously and forms a single broad peak around the middle classes. Extreme short and long leaves are less frequent than intermediate lengths.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 葉長は連続的に変異し、中間の階級付近に1つの大きなピークがあります。非常に短い葉や長い葉は中間的な長さの葉より少なくなっています。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain why a quantitative characteristic such as leaf length can show continuous variation within a population.
markscheme: Quantitative traits can be influenced by multiple genes, so many combinations of alleles can produce a range of phenotypes.
Environmental factors such as light, water or nutrient availability can also influence growth, increasing phenotypic variation.
markschemeJa: 量的形質は複数の遺伝子の影響を受けることがあり、多数の対立遺伝子の組み合わせによって幅広い表現型が生じる。
光、水、栄養条件などの環境要因も成長に影響し、表現型の変異を増やす。
parts.modelAnswer: Continuous variation can arise because many genes contribute to a quantitative trait and because environmental conditions also affect growth. Different genetic combinations and environments therefore produce a wide range of leaf lengths.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 連続変異は、量的形質に複数の遺伝子が関与し、さらに環境条件も成長へ影響することで生じます。遺伝子の組み合わせと環境の違いによって幅広い葉長が現れます。
